page.content:
Raksasi whose palm-leaf fan can quench the Flaming Mountains.

How Princess Iron Fan connects

  • Location: Flaming Mountains — Only Iron Fan's palm-leaf fan can quench the Flaming Mountains.
  • Character: Bull Demon King — The Bull Demon King is Iron Fan's husband and Wukong's fallen brother.

What is Princess Iron Fan?

Princess Iron Fan is wife of the Bull Demon King and mother of Red Boy. The pilgrims cannot pass her mountains until Wukong borrows, steals, and finally wins the use of her fan.

Key threads lead to Flaming Mountains and Bull Demon King.
